subject: Vendor-side PO tagging & VAT split preflight for Concordia Health onboarding
messages:
From: Anna Kaplan <anna.kaplan@concordiahealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@concordiahealth.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood vendor registration + PO / VAT split requirements

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for agreeing to work with Concordia Health. We're starting vendor registration for Redwood so AP can issue POs and route payments. Before we invite Redwood into our portal we need to confirm a few things so the onboarding packet is complete: 

- Vendor legal names and tax IDs for US and EU entities (we need TIN and EU VAT).
- Bank account PDF + bank attestation (for ACH).
- Sample invoice showing PO number field and suggested GL mapping (Concordia requires PO tagging on line items).
- Clarify whether Redwood can accept a single invoice that will be split across entities (we support split remit) or if you prefer separate invoices per entity.
- Any preferred PO acknowledgement SLA (we usually expect acknowledgment within 3 business days).

I've attached our onboarding form (Concordia_AP_Onboarding_Form_v2.pdf) and a link to the vendor portal invite below. Can you return the items by EOB Tue Jan 20 so we can get your first PO over the week of Jan 25?

Portal invite: https://vendors.concordiahealth.com/portal/invite/abc123

Thanks,
Anna Kaplan
Vendor Onboarding, Concordia Health
anna.kaplan@concordiahealth.com
Procurement: procure@concordiahealth.com
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Kaplan <anna.kaplan@concordiahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration + PO / VAT split requirements

Hi Anna — thanks for the checklist and the portal link. We're happy to proceed. Quick answers up front:

- We can accept a single invoice and support split remit by line item, but we need the PO tagging requirements documented (PO field name, expected format).
- A 3-business-day PO ack SLA is fine; we'll confirm via our AP system.

Olga I'm looping you and Jonas in to provide the tax IDs, bank attestation, and a sample invoice template that includes our preferred PO and GL field mappings. Marissa if there are any contract constraints on split invoicing (or billing entity preferences) please advise.

Target: I'll aim to return the completed packet and uploads to the portal by Jan 19 to leave a day of buffer.

Attachment: Sofia-Vendor-Checklist.docx (vendor-side checklist we use for portal submissions)

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com
From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:40:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Redwood vendor registration + PO / VAT split requirements

Hi team — pulling together the requested artifacts. See details below we should send to Concordia: 

1) Tax/legal entities:
- Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) — EIN: 12-3456789 
- Redwood Inference EU Ltd. (Ireland) — VAT: IE3521123E

2) Bank / remittance:
- Bank: First Eastern Bank
- Account holder: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Account: ****2345 (ACH)
- Swift: FEUSUS33
- Attestation: we have a signed bank attestation PDF; will upload via portal.

3) Preferred invoice layout (sample lines):
- Required header fields: Invoice Number, Invoice Date, PO Number (field name: PO_NUMBER), Vendor Tax ID, Remit Entity
- Line-item fields we recommend: PO_NUMBER, LINE_DESCRIPTION, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, LINE_AMT, GL_CODE
- For split remit: include REMIT_ENTITY on each line (values: US_ENTITY, EU_ENTITY). Concordia can split payments by REMIT_ENTITY if they support line-level remit.

4) Short notes on VAT: if Concordia wants gross VAT split, we prefer Concordia issue one invoice with VAT broken out per remit entity; we will accept either separate invoices or a single invoice with VAT_subtotals per REMIT_ENTITY. Need their portal to support VAT split flag (VAT_SPLIT=true).

I'll attach a quick CSV with remittance fields and a sample invoice (redacted).

Attachments to include in outbound to Concordia: Redwood_Remittance_Quick.csv, sample_invoice_redacted.pdf (I'll include when we submit).

Olga Petrov
AP Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwoodinference.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: Redwood vendor registration + PO / VAT split requirements

Quick decision notes — thanks for the draft: 

- Finance is okay with a single invoice split by REMIT_ENTITY as long as Concordia can map REMIT_ENTITY and remit by line. If they cannot, we will provide separate invoices.
- Billing wants PO acknowledgement within 3 business days; if Concordia's portal can't enforce that, we'll accept an email-based PO ack provided PO number is sent and logged.
- Contracts: no additional contraints but we should confirm whether Concordia requires a payee-name match on the invoice header (some customers require legal-name match per remit entity).

Jonas — can your team confirm whether our invoice template can include the exact PO_FIELD they require? If they use a different PO field name we can add a mapping row in the CSV.

Attachment: PO-ack-policy.pdf (internal policy excerpt)

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Anna Kaplan <anna.kaplan@concordiahealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@concordiahealth.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration + PO / VAT split requirements

Sofia / Olga / Marissa — great, thanks for the prompt answers and the attachments. Next steps from Procurement: 

1) I'll send a formal portal invitation (already queued at https://vendors.concordiahealth.com/portal/invite/abc123). Please use that to upload: signed bank attestation, vendor W-9 (for US entity) and VAT certificate (for EU entity), and a redacted sample invoice with PO_NUMBER and REMIT_ENTITY populated.

2) We support line-level split remit. Required portal fields are: PO_FIELD (we accept PO_NUMBER or PO_REF), REMIT_ENTITY (values: US_ENTITY / EU_ENTITY), VAT_SPLIT boolean (set to true). We will split payments based on REMIT_ENTITY.

3) Please complete the portal upload by Jan 20. Once the profile is approved we will generate your first PO and expect vendor acknowledgment within 3 business days. If you prefer DocuSign for the bank attestation/W-9 we can accept that link — I can send one.

I'll open the portal ticket and share a DocuSign link in a follow-up email.

Thanks again — looking forward to the first PO.

Best,
Anna Kaplan
Vendor Onboarding, Concordia Health
